name: Dart logging 1.3.0 — Aivexus bounded local adapter
description: Functional Aivexus diagnostics logging adapter backed by the exact public dart-lang/core logging 1.3.0 source and verified in Linux CI.

provenance.adapter_source: Aivexus adapter separately developed alongside preserved upstream package

security.notes: Functional Linux test is not an independent security/privacy audit. NOT CERTIFIED or production-approved.

integration.adapter_notes: AivexusLoggingModule is a real detached Dart Logger adapter; call emit(eventCode) and snapshot(), dispose to release the buffer. Integrate explicitly via local path dependency; original upstream source and local Aivexus bridge are both in the verified payload.
known_constraints: Only Linux Dart execution is verified. Android, macOS, iOS, Windows and Web remain untested.
Original source is pinned to public Git commit; the separately maintained Aivexus adapter is included in the payload hash.
Event code regex is syntax validation, NOT a domain allowlist or guarantee of absence of personal information. Do not use user content as codes.
No network, storage or global stdout/stderr interception; use only within reviewed isolation boundaries.
No application installation or production certification until independent license/security/privacy approval and target-specific tests.
